_note: W0.6b.S3 staging — 44 pure probe/debug-only flags. Every site was read (not just the name); all 44 confirmed print/collect-only — none gate rendering, physics, load-order, or any other shipped behavior. class=probe, default=off for all. MENU_VOID_SKIP is the one apparent exception (it DOES change what's drawn, via a skip-list) but per PLAN guidance it stays probe: it's a name-substring A/B research tool for isolating which drawable paints a screen region, not a shipped fix (same category as S1's RB3_NO_CLIP/RB3_NO_DEFORM/etc. bisection disables). No reclassifications to workaround were needed. Merged by S4.
